weaknesses.title: TOGGLELINE creates missing path — typo invents ghost flag files
weaknesses.detail: Same create-on-miss class as ENSURELINE/KVFILEINC. Path typo silently seeds new plate; REQUIRE cannot catch miss because create succeeds.

weaknesses.title: TOGGLE on appends to end — loses original index/order
weaknesses.detail: OFF drops in place; ON re-appends. Flag order and TOGGLELINE_I on re-enable differ from pre-toggle position. Agents using order as priority get reordered.
weaknesses.repro: toggle off then on moves line to end

weaknesses.title: Toggle/WRITE omit trailing NL — cat glues flags to next plate
weaknesses.detail: maint=off + META line → visual maint=offline. Recurring plate hygiene issue after DROPEXACT/TOGGLE last-line ops.
weaknesses.repro: cat -A flags META after toggle off

weaknesses.title: WAITFILE only existence — no content/mtime/ready-payload probe
weaknesses.detail: Peer may TOUCH empty ready.flag before writing payload. Agents need second READ/SIZE loop. No WAITFILESIZE or WAITNONEMPTY.
weaknesses.repro: TOUCH ready; WAITFILE hits; content still empty

weaknesses.title: feature_flag_board bag toggle vs TOGGLELINE file — dual families
weaknesses.detail: name:on SETMATCH bag vs exact-line file flip. Agents mix models and corrupt either plate.

weaknesses.title: WAITFILE busy-poll burns CPU; default 30s / cap 120s only lightly advertised
weaknesses.detail: Short waits ok; long agent handoffs block. No backoff or inotify.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens gates
No idempotent desired-state mode (want ON without flip)
weaknesses.detail: Must ENSURE for on and DROPEXACT for off; toggle always flips. Race-prone under concurrent agents.
weaknesses.repro: two agents toggle same line → net no-op or wrong

workarounds: SYS EXIST before TOGGLE if create-on-miss unwanted
Use on/off (ENSURE/DROPEXACT) for desired-state not toggle
WAITFILE then READ/SIZE for payload readiness
Prefer exact lines; never COUNTFILELINE for flags
language_gaps: TOGGLE preserve index or insert-at-old-i on re-enable
WRITE trailing NL preserve on line surgery
Idempotent SETLINE presence API (want on|off without flip)
Help dual bag feature flags vs file TOGGLELINE
